brief:
The UN children's agency UNICEF said Friday that progress in reducing malnutrition across Gaza remains precarious and at risk from supply interruptions entering the Palestinian enclave, according to Al-Monitor. The agency warned that ongoing disruptions could reverse recent advances in addressing widespread hunger and malnutrition among the population.

UNICEF stressed the need to maintain consistent access to food and commercial supplies to sustain improvements in nutritional conditions throughout Gaza.

title: UN warns Gaza malnutrition gains fragile as supply disruptions worsen
